question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**nutritious**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the importance of root crops as staple foods.
 
• The appropriate word should describe the beneficial quality of these staple foods.
 
• "**Nutritious**" (पोषक तत्‍वों से युक्त) fits well as it indicates that these foods provide essential nutrients.
 
• Other options ("**peptic**", "**unhealthy**", "**fattening**") do not fit the context of describing staple foods that are beneficial to health.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The roots of some plants get swollen with the presence__ of storage food which can be used as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are *__*nutritious*__ *staple foods with (3) __________ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water (4)_____. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Peptic **(पाचन से संबंधित): "Peptic" relates to digestion, which does not fit the context of discussing staple foods.
 
• **Unhealthy **(अस्वास्थ्यकर): "Unhealthy" denotes something harmful to health, which contradicts the beneficial aspect of staple foods.
 
• **Fattening **(मोटा करने वाला): "Fattening" means causing weight gain, which is not relevant in the context of nutritious staple foods.
